planets.name: K2-264 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-264 with a 19.7-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-264 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-264. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
